raw_results.question: Which house has the most members? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
RETURN h.name AS houseName, COUNT(p) AS members
ORDER BY members DESC
LIMIT 1

raw_results.question: Which house has the most Knights? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:Knight)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
RETURN h.name AS house, COUNT(k) AS numKnights
ORDER BY numKnights DESC

raw_results.question: Which house has the most Kings? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:King)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
RETURN h.name AS houseName, COUNT(k) AS numberOfKings
ORDER BY numberOfKings DESC
LIMIT 1
